target_profile.system_boundary: The github.com/hashicorp/raft library, including its protocol loops and available repository implementations of storage and transport interfaces. Client FSM semantics and deployment adapter selection lie outside the recovered implementation boundary; library scheduling of those interfaces remains inside it.
protocol_contexts: Leader state is initialized with a fresh commitment object and a start index equal to the last index plus one.
AppendEntries requests carry a replication-state term, previous-log identity, entries, and leader commit index.
Latest and committed configurations are tracked separately.
Protocol-version compatibility changes configuration representation and supported APIs according to config.go documentation.
external_interfaces: Client-provided FSM, optional BatchingFSM, and FSMSnapshot
Client operation futures and leadership notification channels
StableStore and snapshot stores are named or referenced, but their interfaces and implementations are not yet recovered.
ownership: The main leader loop consumes commitment notifications and asynchronous step-down requests.
Per-follower replication work performs synchronous AppendEntries calls.
A separate pipeline decoder processes completed append responses.
Commitment bookkeeping is protected by its own mutex.
Follower AppendEntries processing invokes storage and configuration helpers; actual dispatch ownership, including heartbeat fast-pass behavior, remains unread.
FSM interface comments specify serialized Apply and Snapshot calls and possible concurrent snapshot persistence; scheduler implementation remains unread.
selection_injection: Transport permits a heartbeat fast-pass callback or delivery through Consumer; concrete support and callback installation are unread.
FSM and optional BatchingFSM are implemented by clients.
LogStore optionally advertises monotonic-index requirements, changing documented restore behavior.
Constructor wiring and selected storage, snapshot, and transport implementations are unknown.
The catalogue includes in-memory storage and transport, network transport, and file, in-memory, and discard snapshot implementations; filenames establish retrieval candidates only.
variants: Synchronous and pipelined AppendEntries response processing are visible.
Missing-log replication falls back to snapshot transfer through an unread helper.
Voting and nonvoting participants are distinguished in commitment aggregation.
Leadership transfer has asynchronous coordination and a special candidate flag consulted by AppendEntries.
Optional pre-vote transport support is declared; activation is unknown.
Single-entry and batched FSM interfaces are declared.
Protocol-version and monotonic-log-store alternatives are documented; current selections are unknown.
unknowns: Exact build revision, constructor wiring, active configuration, and selected adapters are not supplied.
Storage failure atomicity and restart durability of built-in variants remain unread.
Election, pre-vote, heartbeat, lease, verification, and term-persistence implementations are incomplete or absent from the supplied ranges.
Offline compilation capability does not establish execution, calibration, or deterministic schedule control.
